destinations.label: clean
destinations.notes: Issuer of the TUSD test stablecoin.
destinations.rationale: Issues TUSD and distributes it only to the TUSD distributor. Its asset is widely held by clean wallets in this run.

destinations.label: clean
destinations.notes: TUSD distributor and DEX market maker.
destinations.rationale: Receives TUSD from the issuer, distributes it to clean wallets, posts a two-sided TUSD/XLM market and creates a TUSD claimable balance for a clean wallet.

destinations.label: clean
destinations.notes: Exchange-style hot wallet that receives deposits tagged with a memo id.
destinations.rationale: Receives deposits from clean wallets with memo-id routing tags, which is how custodial exchanges are normally paid.

destinations.label: clean
destinations.notes: Merchant receiving TUSD payments.
destinations.rationale: Receives TUSD payments for goods from clean wallets.

destinations.label: clean
destinations.notes: Merchant receiving path payments in TUSD.
destinations.rationale: Receives strict-receive path payments that settle in TUSD.

destinations.label: clean
destinations.notes: Fee-bump relayer that pays fees for clean users.
destinations.rationale: Sponsors network fees for a clean payment via a fee-bump envelope. A fee-bump is not itself a risk signal.

destinations.label: clean
destinations.notes: Co-signer added to a clean wallet as a 2-of-2 multisig key.
destinations.rationale: Added as a signer by clean-wallet-04, the same operation shape as a signer takeover, but the signing wallet raises its thresholds so it keeps control. Scored elevated on purpose: a reputation oracle that only sees "newly added signer" would plausibly flag it, so it measures false positives.
destinations.score_rationale: Deliberately outside the clean band (0-25): models an oracle that over-weights this attack-shaped behaviour, so the eval can measure false positives.

destinations.label: clean
destinations.notes: dApp spender granted a small, short-lived Soroban token allowance.
destinations.rationale: Granted a 10 TUSD allowance that expires within ~1 hour. Same operation shape as an approval drain, but bounded in amount and time. Scored elevated on purpose to measure false positives.
destinations.score_rationale: Deliberately outside the clean band (0-25): models an oracle that over-weights this attack-shaped behaviour, so the eval can measure false positives.

destinations.label: clean
destinations.notes: Savings account that receives an account merge from its owner's old wallet.
destinations.rationale: Receives an account merge from clean-closer, which is owned by the same synthetic user and is closing an old account. Same operation shape as a merge drain.

destinations.label: clean
destinations.notes: Payroll wallet that sends multi-op batch payouts to many clean wallets.
destinations.rationale: Sends one multi-operation payroll batch to five clean wallets. High outgoing velocity is a common pass-through feature, so it is scored elevated to measure false positives.
destinations.score_rationale: Deliberately outside the clean band (0-25): models an oracle that over-weights this attack-shaped behaviour, so the eval can measure false positives.

destinations.rationale: Ordinary peer payments only. Its score sits on the extension's tier boundary (<= 20 is low) to catch off-by-one errors in tiering.
